responses.text: I found a lot of November work, so I need to know how to handle the recurring items before I propose anything. I've found about 50 one-time tasks dated in November, plus about 40 recurring tasks (like Standup, Gym, Groceries and Torah study) that repeat through the whole month. Recurring tasks can't be moved by date, so I'd have to end each series on Oct 31 and recreate it from Dec 1, which would lose its history.

tool_calls.name: ask_user

args.question: How should I handle November? I can move the ~50 one-time tasks dated in November to the same day in December. For the ~40 recurring tasks, which would you like?
options: Move one-time tasks, and restart recurring tasks from Dec 1
Leave recurring tasks alone, and move one-time tasks only
